title: Beyond Relevance-Centric Retrieval: Rubric-Oriented Document Set Selection and Ranking
abstract: arXiv:2607.19747v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: As large language models and AI agents become the primary consumers of search results, document set quality determines the upper bound of downstream generation. Yet existing evaluation systems remain confined to scoring documents independently and aggregating via nDCG, ignoring inter-document interactions (redundancy, conflict, complementarity) and unable to answer what makes one document set better than another. To address these issues, we propose a complete evaluate-diagnose-optimize framework. We design SetwiseEvalKit, a three-level, nine-dimension document set evaluation benchmark covering both short-form and long-form scenarios, comprising approximately 28K high-quality evaluation rubrics. We systematically evaluate 12 rerankers: even the best method achieves no more than 45% coverage, cross-document coordination dimensions are universally weak, and no single method maintains top performance across both settings. translated_title: 超越以相关性为中心的检索：面向评分标准的文档集合选择与排序
translated_abstract: 随着大语言模型和AI智能体成为搜索结果的主要消费者，文档集合的质量决定了下游生成效果的上限。然而，现有的评估体系仍然局限于对文档进行独立评分并通过nDCG进行聚合，忽略了文档之间的交互（冗余、冲突、互补），无法回答“什么使得一个文档集合优于另一个文档集合”这一根本问题。为解决这些问题，我们提出了一个完整的“评估-诊断-优化”框架。我们设计了SetwiseEvalKit，这是一个三级九维的文档集合评估基准，涵盖短文本和长文本场景，包含约2.8万条高质量评估评分标准。我们系统地评估了12个重排序方法，发现：即使是最好的方法，其覆盖率也不超过45%；跨文档协调维度的表现普遍较弱；且没有任何单一方法能在两种场景设置下都保持最优性能。在此基础上……
tldr: 该论文提出了一套完整的“评估-诊断-优化”框架，并构建了包含约2.8万条评分标准的三级九维文档集合评估基准SetwiseEvalKit，通过对12个重排序方法的系统评估揭示了现有方法在跨文档协调能力上的普遍缺陷，为面向大模型时代的文档集合选择与排序确立了新的评估范式。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a complete evaluate-diagnose-optimize framework and introduces SetwiseEvalKit, a three-level, nine-dimension document set evaluation benchmark with approximately 28K rubrics, whose systematic evaluation of 12 rerankers reveals universally weak cross-document coordination, establishing a new evaluation paradigm for document set selection and ranking in the era of large language models.
